question: Which country is the largest producer of the cocoa crop, the main ingredient used to make chocolate?
solution:
The correct answer is option **1** i.e __**Ivory Coast.**__

 
• **Ivory Coast** largest producer of the cocoa crop, the main ingredient used to make chocolate

 
 
• Ivory Coast leads the world in the production and export of the cocoa beans.
 
• Ivory Coast supplies around 33% cocoa of the world.
 
• Ivo
